records.name: Melee
records.training: Deal melee damage while a melee-type weapon is equipped.
keyRules: 8 XP per point of melee damage dealt
+1 Melee damage per 10 Melee levels

records.name: Archery
records.training: Attack with a bow and arrows.
keyRules: 8 XP per point of Archery damage dealt
+1 Archery damage per 10 Archery levels
bows provide accuracy; arrows provide damage and are consumed

records.name: Magic
records.training: Attack using staves and magic orbs.
keyRules: staves provide Magic accuracy
elemental orbs interact with monster weaknesses
damage orbs determine spell damage and are consumed unless another mechanic prevents it

records.name: Health
records.training: Gain Health XP through combat damage dealt.
keyRules: 2 Health XP per point of damage dealt
+1 maximum HP per Health level
documented cap 109 HP

records.name: Hunting
keyRules: Hunting has unlockable task upgrades
upgrades modify hunt selection/rewards/behaviour

records.name: Worship
records.training: Bury bones/ashes and interact with worship mechanics.
keyRules: Worship Points begin at 1 and increase by 1 per Worship level
cemeteries refill Worship Points
abilities include movement, teleport, digging and other utility effects

records.name: Mining
records.training: Mine ore/rock nodes with a pickaxe.
keyRules: starts with a bronze pickaxe
higher Mining levels and better pickaxes reduce mining ticks
mining consumes Sleep Points
rare gems can be obtained while mining

records.name: Forging
keyRules: bars are smelted at a furnace
weapons/armour and other products are forged at anvils
higher-tier metals require increasing fuel/material requirements

records.name: Crafting
records.training: Craft items from logs, hides, bars, gems and other materials.
keyRules: crafting can be started by left-clicking a log to open recipes
products include bows, staves, arrows, armour, vials and gems

records.name: Enchantment
records.training: Enchant orbs, armour, gems, weapons and related items.
keyRules: Stardust and unpowered orbs are core inputs for orb enchanting
elemental shrines determine orb type

records.name: Fishing
records.training: Use fishing spots with the required fishing tool/bait.
keyRules: fishing consumes Sleep Points
different fish require different tools/locations/levels

records.name: Farming
records.training: Plant and harvest crops at farming plots.
keyRules: plots exist in multiple regions and a Greenhouse
crops have growth timers
farming contracts provide additional progression

records.name: Woodcutting
keyRules: tree tiers progress from normal/oak/willow/maple and beyond
higher levels/tools improve access and speed

records.name: Firemaking
records.training: Light fires using logs and matches.
keyRules: fires can be made in many world tiles but not teleport tiles
log types have different burn times and XP

records.name: Cooking
records.training: Cook raw food on fires and use ovens for recipes such as pies.
keyRules: fires cook ordinary food
ovens support pie cooking
special potion-created fires/ovens can increase cooking speed

records.name: Brewing
records.training: Create potions and use fermenting systems.
keyRules: base potion duration is documented as 5 minutes plus 30 seconds per Brewing level
some potions alter gathering/production behaviour

records.name: Stealing
records.training: Pickpocket NPCs, steal from stalls and open stealable chests.
keyRules: some stalls are guarded
Silent Gloves can bypass some guard requirements

records.name: Agility
keyRules: Agility grants movement/dodge progression
documented passive unlocks include permanent running outside combat at level 20 and running during combat at level 40
